data.name: CommonProblems.Form.Title
data.value: G PC Health Check — common problems

data.name: CommonProblems.Form.Intro
data.value: Additional network, printing, and device checks. The main health score is not changed. Collection does not perform repairs. INFO means limited information; UNKNOWN means insufficient data. Windows Settings are opened for manual engineer work.

data.name: CommonProblems.Status.CancelRequested
data.value: Cancellation requested; waiting for the current WMI provider to return.

data.name: CommonProblems.Status.CommandRunning
data.value: A confirmed command is running; the window can be closed after its result is received.

data.name: CommonProblems.Status.Snapshot
data.value: Snapshot {0:HH:mm:ss}. Rechecking does not replace user confirmation that the symptom is resolved.

data.name: CommonProblems.Status.Cancelled
data.value: Collection cancelled. Previous results were not replaced.

data.name: CommonProblems.Dns.Confirm
data.value: Use only for name-resolution symptoms. The local DNS cache will be cleared; DNS servers, IP configuration, proxy, and VPN are not changed. This does not fix DHCP, missing DNS, or an unavailable server. Configuration will be read again after the command, and access to the affected resource must be checked separately. Continue?

data.name: CommonProblems.Export.Description
data.value: Select a local folder. Reports contain device names/IP addresses; do not publish them without review.

data.name: CommonProblems.Report.Scope
data.value: Additional network, printing, and device checks. They do not change the main Health Score. INFO does not confirm health, UNKNOWN means insufficient data. A repeat snapshot and a successful command exit code do not prove that the root cause was fixed.
